messages:
emma: Heads-up: nightly recon found 52 invoices where Stripe total != NetSuite total. Pattern: Stripe started sending `aggregate_discount` on lines recently and our parser ignored it, so line totals were higher.
prashant: Where did this land? DLQ or already applied to NetSuite?
emma: Most went straight through. Consumer sees new field under `lines.data[].aggregate_discount`. Example: "aggregate_discount": {"amount": 300, "type":"bundle"}. We only summed `line.amount` and `line.discount_amount` previously.
sam: I can patch parser to normalize `aggregate_discount` into `discount_amount` during ingest. Will add integration test and metric `webhook.discount.aggregate_seen`.
finance-bot: daily-recon (#daily-recon) detected 52 mismatches, total delta $3,410. Job link: /jobs/8899
prashant: Finance will approve backfill if total < $5k. Please produce CSV with invoice_id, customer, delta, and Stripe event ids.
emma: Generating CSV now and running dry-run: `./scripts/backfill_credits.py --file=/secure-drive/finance/aggdisc_2241234567.csv --dry-run`
sam: Opened PR: https://internal/git/stripe-consumer/pull/523 - summary: normalize `aggregate_discount` → `line.discount_amount`, add unit/e2e tests. Canary in staging then 10%-prod.
emma: Dry-run output: 52 records, total credit $3,410. Uploaded CSV to /secure-drive/finance/aggdisc_2241234567.csv
finance-bot: Backfill scheduled after approval: job_id=99001 ETA 12m
prashant: Finance approves. Please include audit note referencing PR and event ids. Also add monitor: `webhook.aggregate_discount.count` and alert if > 0 after fix.
sam: Deployed normalization to staging; metric shows 0 in staging. Will roll to canary in 30m.
emma: Kicking off backfill (rate 6/s). Will post results when done.
finance-bot: Backfill complete: 52 credit memos created. Journal refs in /secure-drive/finance/aggdisc_journals_2241234567.csv
prashant: Thanks. Filing FIN-502 for RCA: cause = schema evolution `aggregate_discount` not handled; fix = parser normalization + tests + metric + alert.
